An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of XAML files. When an XAML file is downloaded, Microsoft Edge does not set appropriate file permissions. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user at medium integrity. title: Microsoft Edge XAML File Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Edge. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of XAML files. When an XAML file is downloaded, Microsoft Edge does not set appropriate file permissions. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user at medium integrity.
